basic_details.job_title: SMC Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 18 Chief Fire Officer, Instrumentation Technician Posts
basic_details.short_information: Surat Municipal Corporation (SMC) (સુરત મહાનગરપાલિકા) is inviting online applications to prepare a waiting list for 18 posts: 1 Chief Fire Officer (ચીફ ફાયર ઓફીસર) (future vacancy, Pay Matrix Rs. 67700-208700, Level-11) and 17 Instrumentation Technician posts (first three years fixed monthly salary Rs. 16,500/-). Applications are accepted on suratmunicipal.gov.in from 11:00 AM on 18 November 2026 to 11:00 PM on 2 December 2026. The fee is Rs. 500 for unreserved candidates and Rs. 400 for reserved categories.

age_limit.details: Age is counted on 2 December 2026. Reserved category candidates of Gujarat origin get relaxation as per Government rules from time to time, but age may not exceed 45 years. The age limit does not apply to SMC regular-pay employees, but it does apply to SMC trainees on fixed monthly pay. Women candidates who are married may apply with a marriage certificate or Government Gazette entry in the husband's name; unmarried women or those without such proof apply in the father's name. Women get age relaxation as per the Government's current rules. | Candidates should read the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

vacancy_details.Reservation as printed: 1 post reserved for Divyangjan; category-wise break-up is in the notice table

category_wise_breakdown.reservation_as_printed: 1 post reserved for Divyangjan; category-wise break-up is in the notice table

how_to_apply: Open the SMC website and register as a user: e-mail address, mobile number and captcha, then verify the OTP sent to the mobile.
Enter first name, last name and password to complete the account, then verify the e-mail through the link sent.
Log in, complete the user profile and click Apply Now against the post after studying the advertisement PDF.
Fill personal details, educational qualification, experience and document details; declare that the information is correct.
Upload a photo (up to 150 KB, 5 cm height and 3.6 cm width) and a signature (up to 50 KB, 2.5 cm height and 7.5 cm width, in black or blue on white paper) in JPG, JPEG or PNG format.
Check the preview, click Confirm & Pay and pay the fee online. Download the receipt; it is also e-mailed.

Fee is paid online only; cash, demand draft and postal order are not accepted. Once confirmed, the form cannot be edited and the fee is not refundable. If a correction is needed, the candidate must re-register and fill a new form; the earlier form stands cancelled without refund. A candidate may submit only one application per post.
Proof of date of birth: school leaving certificate or SSC/HSC certificate.
Educational certificates and mark sheets; grade-to-percentage conversion as per university rules.
Experience certificates showing period, designation and salary; self-declaration or affidavit is not accepted.
Caste certificate for SC, ST and SEBC; SEBC candidates need a non-creamy layer certificate issued on or after 1 April 2024, in the Gujarati format; the English Annexure-A is not accepted.
EWS candidates: eligibility certificate in the prescribed Gujarati format, issued on or before the last date.
Disability certificate and UDID for Divyangjan; marriage certificate or Gazette for married women; Aadhaar, EPIC and PAN card copies.
important_instructions: SMC regular employees and trainees must also apply online, then send the application with a copy of the last pay slip through their department with the competent authority's permission to the Central Establishment (Recruitment) Department within 6 days after the last date; late receipt may lead to rejection. Government, semi-government or company employees must produce a No Objection Certificate at document verification. Candidates previously retired, resigned or removed from Government or public service must state this; concealment may cancel the appointment. Reserved category candidates may apply for unreserved posts, but then only the unreserved selection criteria apply. Candidates must keep the registered mobile number and e-mail active; SMC is not responsible if messages are not received. Fake or false documents lead to rejection; SMC may cancel or change the recruitment at any time and no claim will be accepted. Divyangjan need at least 40% disability and must state the disability type; the notice lists suitable types for each post.
For queries call the Central Establishment (Recruitment) Department on 0261-2423751-54, Ext. 231/299.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 18 vacancies in total. The Chief Fire Officer post is a vacancy expected to arise in the future; the Instrumentation Technician posts are current vacancies. Applications are invited to make a waiting list (pratikshayadi). SC, ST, SEBC and EWS reservations apply only to candidates of Gujarat origin in those categories. Women's reservation is 33% of the posts in each category.

rows.reservation_as_printed: 1 post reserved for Divyangjan; category-wise break-up is in the notice table

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Degree from a university set up under a Central or State Act, or an institution recognised or deemed a university under Section 3 of the University Grants Commission Act, 1956. Experience: about seven years' whole-time service in the Fire Brigade, of which three years on a post not below Station Officer or Assistant Divisional Officer or equivalent, in Government, local bodies, Government Undertaking Board, Corporation or a Limited Company established under the Companies Act, 2013. Basic computer knowledge as prescribed in the Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules 1967. Physical and medical standards as per Appendix-A and adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi or both. Age: not more than 45 years. Appendix-A standards for men: height 160 cm for Scheduled Tribes of Gujarat origin and 165 cm for others; chest 81 cm deflated and 86 cm inflated; weight 50 kg; chest expansion at least 5 cm. For women: height 154.5 cm (ST of Gujarat origin) or 157 cm (others); weight 46 kg. Knock knee, pigeon chest, squint eye, flat feet, varicose veins, hammer toes, fractured limb, decayed teeth, communicable disease or skin disease make a candidate unfit. A Medical Officer certifies fitness under S H A P E I (Psychological, Hearing, Appendage, Physical capacity, Eyesight). I.T.I. (Instrumentation). Experience: minimum 2 years in industrial automation control system theory, troubleshooting of field instruments, equipment and PLC based control systems, and calibration of water quality lab and field instruments. SCADA experience will be preferable. Age: not more than 35 years. Age is counted on 2 December 2026. Reserved category candidates of Gujarat origin get relaxation as per Government rules from time to time, but age may not exceed 45 years. The age limit does not apply to SMC regular-pay employees, but it does apply to SMC trainees on fixed monthly pay. Women candidates who are married may apply with a marriage certificate or Government Gazette entry in the husband's name; unmarried women or those without such proof apply in the father's name. Women get age relaxation as per the Government's current rules. Candidates should read the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: Bachelor's degree plus Divisional Officers Course or Fire Prevention Course (National Fire Service College, Nagpur); OR B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc in Fire or Fire and Safety. Experience: about seven years in Fire Brigade.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Chief Fire Officer: Pay Band 15600-39100, Grade Pay 6600; Pay Matrix Rs. 67700-208700 (Level-11). Instrumentation Technician: first three years fixed monthly salary Rs. 16,500/-; then Pay Band 5200-20200, Grade Pay 1900; Pay Matrix Rs. 19900-63200 (Level-2). Chief Fire Officer must complete the Divisional Officer's Course at the National Fire Service College or a recognised institute during probation. Probation may be extended by one year if the Appointing Authority is satisfied the delay was beyond the candidate's control. Those who have already completed the course need not repeat it. A selected candidate who has not passed the computer examination (CCC/CCC+ or equivalent) must pass it within one year of appointment. The notice states that candidates with an equivalent degree or SMC computer training submit proof.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: SMC will prepare a waiting list. The Standing Committee (for Chief Fire Officer) and the Appointing Authority (for Instrumentation Technician) will fix the selection criteria based on basic qualification and/or experience, and may hold a retention test, practical test or oral interview depending on the number of applications. Candidates are told about call letters by message on the registered mobile and e-mail after the call letter is published on the SMC website. Document verification is done in original; candidates bear their own expenses for verification and tests. The final waiting list follows the recruitment rules and Staff Selection Committee decisions; where merit is equal, the older candidate is preferred. The notice does not give test dates or a syllabus.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in SMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 18 vacancies: 1 Chief Fire Officer (future vacancy) and 17 Instrumentation Technician posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date is 2 December 2026, up to 11:00 PM. Applications opened at 11:00 AM on 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Instrumentation Technician?
faq.answer: I.T.I. (Instrumentation) with a minimum of 2 years' experience in industrial automation control systems, field instruments and PLC based control. SCADA experience is preferable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Chief Fire Officer?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's degree plus a Divisional Officers Course or Fire Prevention Course recognised by the National Fire Service College, Nagpur, or a B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc in Fire or Fire and Safety, with about seven years' Fire Brigade experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Not more than 45 years for Chief Fire Officer and not more than 35 years for Instrumentation Technician, counted on 2 December 2026, with relaxation for reserved categories of Gujarat origin as per rules (age not above 45 years).

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Chief Fire Officer: Pay Matrix Rs. 67700-208700 (Level-11). Instrumentation Technician: Rs. 16,500 fixed monthly for the first three years, then Pay Matrix Rs. 19900-63200 (Level-2).

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: Rs. 500 for unreserved candidates and Rs. 400 for all women, SEBC, EWS, SC, ST and Divyangjan. It is paid online and is not refundable.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply for SMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Register and apply online at https://www.suratmunicipal.gov.in, upload photo and signature, and pay the fee through Confirm & Pay.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for both posts?
faq.answer: Yes, but only one application per post is valid; if more than one is made for a post, the last confirmed application counts.

faq.question: Q10. Is the job permanent or a waiting list?
faq.answer: The advertisement invites applications to prepare a waiting list (pratikshayadi) for the posts; the Instrumentation Technician posts carry a fixed monthly salary for the first three years.
